description: Change a draft before render. Free. Every scene number refers to the draft as it is now (1-based); operations apply in the order edits, reorder, remove, insert. edits: change a scene's narration (verbatim), visual (null clears it → auto image), seconds, speaker or voice (null = the narrator). insert: add scenes after scene N (0 = at the start). remove: scene numbers to drop. reorder: every current scene number in the new order. Returns the updated draft — show it to the user again.

artStyle.description: Visual style; see autoshort_list_niches. Default AUTOSHORTS (cinematic photography).

aspectRatio.description: Frame of the rendered video: "9:16" vertical (default; Shorts/TikTok/Reels), "16:9" landscape (YouTube, film), "1:1" square. Images are generated in this shape and the video renders in it. 16:9 and 1:1 skip the automatic music bed and punch-in polish (vertical only).

speaker.description: Who speaks the scene; null = the narrator.

voice.description: Google voice name for this scene; null = the video's voice.

clip_id.description: Film assembly: the id of one of YOUR finished motion clips (autoshort_generate_motion_clip, status COMPLETED). The scene plays that clip (held on its last frame or trimmed to the narration) with this scene's narration/dialogue and captions over it. No extra credits, never regenerated. Not together with image_url.

image_url.description: Optional. Show the user's OWN image in this scene instead of a generated one (https URL, JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 10 MB). Animated WebP uses its first frame; GIF and SVG are rejected. Downloaded once, cleaned (EXIF/GPS removed) and served from AutoShort. Same limits as image_urls on autoshort_generate_chat_video.

narration.description: Exactly what the voice reads for this scene. Read verbatim — never rewritten.

seconds.description: Desired shot length. The spoken narration sets the real length; a mismatch is reported in warnings[].

speaker.description: Who speaks this scene's narration, e.g. "Narrator", "Nhược Ly", "Tần Phong". A label shown back in the draft; omit for the narrator.

visual.description: What the viewer SEES in this scene, as a shot description ("close-up of hands holding a coffee and a planner, morning light"). Becomes the image prompt as written, plus the art style. Omit to let AutoShort pick an image from the narration.

voice.description: The voice that reads THIS scene: a Google voice name from autoshort_list_options voices.list, e.g. "vi-VN-Chirp3-HD-Charon" (male) or "vi-VN-Chirp3-HD-Aoede" (female). Use one voice per character and keep it on every line that character speaks; omit for the video's narrator voice. Free (no extra credits). ElevenLabs ids are not accepted per scene.

language.description: BCP-47 narration language ("en", "vi", …). Omit to detect it from the narration.

targetDuration.description: Requested length in seconds. Kept as requested — if the verbatim narration cannot fit it, warnings[] says so with a word count that would.

title.description: Headline shown over the first 1.5s and used as the video title. Defaults to the first sentence.
